It is only 0.24 hectares, so I will not buy a full bag just for this piece, but if I can get fertilizer through subsidy or share with someone, I will put some because maize and improved seed pay better when I feed it. I own this land, so I will also carry manure onto it, and because it is intercropped and near home, my family will do most of the work without hiring many people.
